title: The best gift for Being Here Now :-))
text: The best gift for Being Here Now :-)). [[VIDEOID:40442cf67349a6327a3941c9c7dd2d1b]] This Now clock is perfect for my meditation room and looks so good above my puja table (see the video).  It’s unique in that there are no hands as the time is Now!  :-)).  Great company with a sense of humor:  “Guaranteed to keep perfect time for life.  Automatically adjusts for Daylight Savings Time, and accurate in all time zones:-))).  I would highly recommend this product!  Great packaging.

product_metadata.title: Now Clock - Mindfulness, Zen, Buddhist Decor for Your Home, Office, Yoga or Meditation Room - Unique Gift That Helps You to Be Present & Relax into The Power of Now - (Om Pendulum)
features: ✅ The Now Clock is the perfect gift to help you SLOW DOWN, RELAX and APPRECIATE THE PRESENT MOMENT.

✅ On first glance, it looks like a conventional wall clock, but there are no hands, just the word NOW, and a pendulum that SLOWLY swings back and forth, SILENTLY, catching your eye and reminding you that THE TIME IS NOW!
✅ The perfect focal point for anyone into MINDFULNESS, MEDITATION, YOGA, ZEN, or SIMPLE MINIMALIST LIVING.
✅ Ideal for anyone who loves ‘THE POWER OF NOW’ book, by Eckhart Tolle, ‘BE HERE NOW’ by Ram Dass, Jon Kabat-Zinn mindfulness.
✅ Great conversation starter! The Now Clock will give you a lifetime of MINDFULNESS AND SMILES :)
